{{Top|leg}}
A '''Garqian''' was a non-native being either born on or that claimed permanent residence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Garqi/Legends|Garqi]]. It was also used as a proper adjective to refer to anything related to, coming from, or similar to that on Garqi.
